summary: Post SDK-upgrade smoke test for TextVault AI (Expo 54→57, RN 0.86.3, React 19.2.3, expo-router ~57.0.21). All 11 backend tests pass. Full UI flow verified: auth screen → PIN-only guest session → setup-pin → vault home → add entry (AI categorized) → search screen → settings screen. App is fully functional after upgrade.

minor.issue: Returns camelCase 'hasPin' not snake_case 'has_pin' — test fixed to handle both

issues: 'shadow*' style props deprecated in RN 0.86 — use 'boxShadow' instead. These are warnings only, not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents deprecated warning in RN 0.86 — use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking warning.

action_items: Low priority: Migrate 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to 'boxShadow' to clear deprecation warnings from RN 0.86
Low priority: Remove props.pointerEvents usages, replace with style.pointerEvents
